primary: Semantic-logit mean over all cyclic rotations; report direct canonical and every rotation as controls.
secondary: Role-pair symmetric average of the cyclic means; it imposes role invariance and is not itself evidence of correct knowledge.
energy: Centered aligned-logit disagreement is descriptive. It is not a physical residual-stream potential, a calibrated confidence or a correctness guarantee.
scope_limit: Repeated calibration f00, unfinished task, target_slot=0, two ticks remaining. No arithmetic-transfer claim from fixed-two timing.
fitting: No learned coefficients, temperature or threshold; uniform fixed averages only.
